def flood_fill_from_corners(grid, rows, cols, fg_value):
    """Find cells NOT reachable from any corner via background cells"""
    background = [v for v in range(10) if v != fg_value][0]  # Assume binary for now

# Fill cells in rows 4-11, at cols that have FG in row 3
